A01: Keys and sessions are independent random credentials; only digests persist, account identity is immutable and invalid credentials fail.
A02: Idle and absolute session expiry are enforced by the server; activity never extends the absolute lifetime.
A03: Login replacement, logout, key rotation and account disablement revoke the affected sessions; enabling does not resurrect them.
A04: Accounts retain at most eight sessions and a new login stays usable without evicting another account's sessions.
A05: Domain writes recheck session/account validity in their SQL batch and roll back after revocation, leaving no transient guards.
A06: A key rotated before login commits cannot issue a usable session.
A07: Provision unique immutable HTTPS actors only on explicit account creation, preserving default URNs and capturing inputs before async work.
